description: B2 factorial comparison: driven two-level system, D^alpha rho = L[rho] on tau in [0,1] (T_r = tau_c); factors: output map x initial condition x gate, at equal network, optimiser budget and collocation mesh

network.outputs: 2 d^2 real outputs for every map (d^2 - 1 for the minimal 'bloch' head)

maps.note: gate2 and gate2b coincide with factor when rho0 has full rank (mixed, nearly_pure), so they are run for the pure state only

soft_ic.selection: per (map, alpha): weight with the smallest geometric mean of rel_fro over the three states and the pilot seeds; pilot seeds are disjoint from the reported seeds

untuned_reference.note: soft IC with weight 1 is the baseline of the first campaign (Direct, SP-soft)

test.definition: tau = 0, the midpoints (j - 1/2)/1000 and 40 log-spaced points per decade on [1e-12, 1]; see fracsp.pinn.test_grid and state_metrics
